title: Exploring a phantom Dirac-Born-Infeld regular black hole via particle emission, wave scattering and geodesics
summary: We examine particle creation, evaporation, scalar wave absorption and scattering, and geodesic motion in the asymptotically flat regular black hole supported by a phantom Dirac-Born-Infeld field. For massless bosonic and fermionic fields, the Bogoliubov transformations yield thermal spectra whose Hawking temperature decreases as the regular core becomes more prominent. Energy-conserving tunneling recovers the same temperature in the low-energy limit, whereas recoil and the DBI contribution introduce nonthermal corrections and suppress particle emission.
